tts_guide.title: Guide to Getting TTS Audio API Keys
tts_guide.description: Step-by-step instructions for VoiceVox, OpenAI, Google TTS, and ElevenLabs API keys to generate native Japanese audio for Flama flashcards.
tts_guide.alert_title: Why should you use your personal API Key?
tts_guide.alert_desc: Flama supports direct integration with popular Text-to-Speech engines. Personal API Keys ensure rapid audio synthesis, avoid shared bandwidth throttling, and give you complete control over voice quality.

voicevox.desc: Natural Japanese native voice synthesis (Shikikoin Metan, Kasukabe Tsumugi, Namine Ritsu...)
voicevox.step1_desc: Click the link below or visit the free key generation website directly:
voicevox.step2_desc: On Su-Shiki, click Generate Key and copy your generated API Key string.
voicevox.step3_desc: Open Flama, navigate to Browse > Select card > Click VoiceVox TTS > Paste key into VoiceVox API Key field.
voicevox.points_alert_desc: Each voice playback or audio generation deducts a small point amount from your key. Points regenerate over time, or you can generate a fresh key on Su-Shiki.

openai.title: OpenAI TTS
openai.desc: High quality AI voices (Alloy, Echo, Fable, Onyx, Nova, Shimmer).
openai.step1: Log in to your account at platform.openai.com.
openai.step2: Go to API Keys > Select Create new secret key.
openai.step3: Copy the key string starting with sk-... and store it securely.

elevenlabs.title: ElevenLabs
elevenlabs.desc: Ultra-realistic emotional voice synthesis with fine prosody controls.
elevenlabs.step2: Click your profile picture at bottom left > Profile + API Key.
elevenlabs.step3: Click the eye icon to reveal and copy your personal API Key.

google.title: Google Cloud / Gemini
google.desc: Multi-lingual speech synthesis and cutting-edge Google AI models.
google.step2: Click Get API key > Select Create API key.
google.step3: Copy the key code and save it for use.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions & Key Security
faq.q1: Is my API Key securely stored on Flama?
faq.a1: Yes. On Flama, all user-provided keys are encrypted with military-grade encryption (Fernet / AES-256) prior to storage and only invoked upon your explicit action.
faq.q2: Am I required to provide an API Key?
faq.a2: No, pre-generated audio plays without a key. A personal key is only required when performing batch VoiceVox generation for custom cards in the Browse view.

audio_guide.description: Windows Desktop app providing unlimited local VOICEVOX & Kokoro TTS synthesis engines for Flama.
audio_guide.warning_desc: Because FlamaAudio-Portable.exe is self-compiled, Windows SmartScreen may flag a warning. To launch:

unlimited.title: Unlimited & Free
unlimited.desc: Synthesize voice directly on PC hardware without API costs or quota limits.

pair.title: Secure Pairing (PNA Token)
pair.desc: Private Network Access protected by Pair Code approval, keeping your machine completely safe.

engines.title: VOICEVOX & Kokoro Offline
engines.desc: Built-in natural Japanese character voices plus multi-lingual Kokoro model with pitch and speed sliders.

steps.title: Startup & Usage Workflow
steps.subtitle: Takes less than 1 minute to setup local speech synthesis on Windows.
steps.s1_desc: Download FlamaAudio-Portable.exe and run directly; service starts on port 4791.
steps.s2_desc: In Deck Audio Generator or Browse, click connect device.
steps.s3_desc: Flama Audio Desktop will prompt a dialogue. Click Approve to securely register token.
steps.s4_desc: Select character voice, adjust parameters, and generate speech for thousands of cards.

callout.title: Experience Audio Generation Now
callout.desc: Automatically scan decks and batch generate audio with a single click.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions & Troubleshooting
faq.q1: App reports "Cannot connect to Flama Audio Service (port 4791)"?
faq.a1: Ensure Flama Audio Desktop (FlamaAudio-Portable.exe) is open. If blocked by Windows Firewall, allow access on Private networks.
faq.q2: How do I install the VOICEVOX Engine?
faq.a2: Flama Audio Desktop includes automated engine management. Simply click "Download & Install Engine" in Desktop app when prompted.
